fields.Name: IT170 - Transaction Group Concurrency over GraphQL
fields.Description: Two independent GraphQL sessions of one user edit MJ: User Settings rows; session A saves through a transaction group of two updates. TGC1 a stale grouped update of the field session B changed refuses the whole group: B's value is stored, the group's other update did not land, and A's entity names the conflicting field; TGC2 a stale grouped update of a different field commits and B's column survives; TGC3 a stale grouped update converging on B's value commits; TGC4 a grouped update saved with SkipOldValuesCheck is not checked and overwrites B's value. Mutating; self-cleaning.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: A transaction group's updates are checked for concurrent changes exactly as single-record updates are, and a conflict anywhere rolls back the whole group.
